notes.title: Community Items are now live! (Trading Cards, Backgrounds, etc.)
notes.content:
[h1]The Community Items are here![/h1]
I am happy to announce, that [b]Your amazing T-gotchi[/b] has finally met the requirements for the Community Items! Now all the [i]Backgrounds, Emoticons and Trading card[/i]s are available for sale and trading. Don't miss them!
Now available:
[list]
[*] [b]5 Trading Cards[/b]
[*] [b]7 Emoticons[/b]
[*][b] 3 Profile Backgrounds[/b]
[/list]

tags.feature: Now all the Backgrounds, Emoticons and Trading cards are available for sale and trading.

notes.title: German and Polish translations added
notes.content:
Hey guys! Thanks to the wonderful translators [b]Agnieszka Kołodziej [/b] and [b]Timo (Twitter:@timo3400)[/b]
the game is now available in Polish and German.

The full list of localizations is now:
[list]
[*]English
[*]Korean
[*]Russian
[*]Spanish
[*]Hungarian
[*]Brasilian Portuguese 
[*]Italian
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]Polish
[*]German
[/list]

tags.feature: the game is now available in Polish and German.
